newsitem.title: UK: Tesco launches weekly prize draw.
newsitem.headline: Tesco launches weekly prize draw.

text.p: British supermarket group Tesco Plc said on Friday it was launching a weekly prize draw using its ClubCard loyalty card with offers including a year's free shopping.
The draw, called "Swipe it Lucky," will run for six weeks from June 9 and will be free to enter for Tesco ClubCard holders.
"Swipe it Lucky gives all our customers the chance to win a year's free shopping and many other prizes," marketing director Tim Mason said in a statement.
Tesco said the competition carried a one-in-40 chance of winning.
Tesco said there were currently 10 million ClubCard members. The loyalty scheme was launched in February 1995. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
